// Urza's Saga, the artifact its third chapter goes and gets, and lands.
//
// Sixteen cards, so a run to turn 5 on the draw still has a library left after
// the fetch. The Saga is an Enchantment Land, so it arrives on a land drop;
// chapter III resolves two turns later and puts Lantern of Insight onto the
// battlefield, if the library still holds it. The criteria files beside this
// one ask that question with the Saga declared, without it, and in the
// clause-by-clause phrasing lantern.criteria.toml uses, which must agree.
1x Urza's Saga [Land - Saga]
1x Lantern of Insight [Lantern - Vision]
4x Island [Land]
10x Lightning Bolt [Burn]
